group.name: DERGridForming
group.label: DER Grid-Forming Control Model
group.desc: Grid-forming (GFM) control-law parameters, current-limiting behavior, observability points, black-start sequencing, multi-unit coordination, and synchronization controls in grid-forming inverter products

points.desc: Model identifier
points.label: Model ID
points.name: ID

points.desc: Model length.
points.label: Model Length
points.name: L

points.desc: Current Grid Operation Mode — commanded mode the inverter is operating in.
points.label: Grid Operation Mode
points.name: GridMd

points.desc: Runtime state machine reflecting where the inverter is in its mode-transition / start-up sequence.
points.label: Grid Operation State
points.name: GridSt

points.desc: Selected GFM control algorithm. Products typically support a subset of these strategies; the full enum is exposed so any strategy can be represented without a model change.
points.label: Control Algorithm
points.name: CtrlAlg

points.desc: P-f droop coefficient. Per-unit frequency change per per-unit power change (e.g. 0.05 = 5% droop). Convert to Hz/W as m_p = DroopP * Hz_nom / S_rated.
points.detail: Reference tuning: 0.05 pu/pu (5% droop) per UNIFI Consortium Specifications v2.
points.label: P-f Droop Coefficient
points.name: DroopP

points.desc: Q-V droop coefficient. Per-unit voltage change per per-unit reactive-power change.
points.label: Q-V Droop Coefficient
points.name: DroopQ

points.desc: Virtual inertia constant H (swing equation). 0 = pure droop, no inertia. Typical range 1-10 s.
points.detail: Reference tuning: 2.5 s, the minimum inertia constant for grid-forming energy storage under ERCOT AGS-ESR.
points.label: Virtual Inertia H
points.name: InertiaH

points.desc: Swing-equation damping, expressed as a damping ratio (1.0 = critical, below 1 underdamped, above 1 overdamped). Applied to the transient frequency component only, so it does not bias the steady-state droop response.
points.label: Damping Ratio
points.name: Damping

points.desc: Damper time constant that decouples the fast transient damper response from the slow governor / droop response. Damping acts on frequency excursions faster than this constant.
points.label: Damper Decoupler Time Constant
points.name: DampTms

points.desc: Virtual reactance applied by the GFM voltage-source emulator. Shapes output impedance for stability and current sharing. Real GFM control parameter — not the physical LCL filter.
points.detail: Reference tuning: 0.30 pu emulated stator reactance; total plant impedance target at or below 0.5 pu including transformer and step-up.
points.label: Virtual Reactance
points.name: VirtualX

points.desc: Virtual resistance applied by the GFM voltage-source emulator. Often 0 or small; used for damping / current limiting on some products.
points.detail: Reference tuning: 0.05 pu (about one fundamental cycle time constant).
points.label: Virtual Resistance
points.name: VirtualR

points.desc: Low-pass filter time constant applied to P/Q feedback in the droop loop. Real GFM products expose this for stability tuning. ms.
points.detail: Reference tuning: about 20 ms (RMS estimation window).
points.label: Power Measurement Filter Time Constant
points.name: FilterTms

points.desc: Active-power dispatch setpoint.
points.label: P Setpoint
points.name: WSet

points.desc: Reactive-power dispatch setpoint.
points.label: Q Setpoint
points.name: VarSet

points.desc: Voltage reference for the GFM voltage-source emulator (line-neutral).
points.label: Voltage Reference
points.name: VRef

points.desc: Frequency reference for the GFM oscillator.
points.label: Frequency Reference
points.name: HzRef

points.desc: Maximum upward P slew rate applied to setpoint changes.
points.label: P Ramp Up Rate
points.name: PRmpUp

points.desc: Maximum downward P slew rate applied to setpoint changes.
points.label: P Ramp Down Rate
points.name: PRmpDn

points.desc: Maximum V slew rate during normal operation.
points.label: V Ramp Rate
points.name: VRmp

points.desc: Maximum Hz slew rate during normal operation.
points.label: Hz Ramp Rate
points.name: HzRmp

points.desc: Continuous current limit, per phase.
points.label: Continuous Current Limit
points.name: IMaxCont

points.desc: Transient (short-duration) current limit during faults.
points.detail: Reference overload envelope: 2.0 pu for 1-2 fundamental cycles (fault response), then 1.6 pu for about 0.5 s (inertial recovery).
points.label: Transient Current Limit
points.name: IMaxTrans

points.desc: Duration the transient limit is permitted before falling back to continuous limit. ms.
points.label: Transient Limit Duration
points.name: IMaxDur

points.desc: Current-limit strategy. The single most contested area of real GFM products — different vendors pick different behaviors under fault.
points.label: Current Limit Strategy
points.name: LimMode

points.desc: Maximum instantaneous overcurrent before a hard trip.
points.label: Instantaneous Overcurrent Trip
points.name: IInst

points.desc: Maximum permitted rate-of-change of frequency before protection acts.
points.detail: Reference capability: ride through 5 Hz/s (IEEE 2800); withstand 1 Hz/s for 0.5 s (ERCOT AGS-ESR).
points.label: ROCOF Limit
points.name: ROCOFLim

points.desc: Maximum power angle stroke before pole-slip trip.
points.detail: Reference capability: ride through phase jumps up to 25 degrees without tripping (IEEE 2800).
points.label: Maximum Angle Stroke
points.name: MaxAng

points.desc: Internal voltage angle of the GFM oscillator at the inverter terminal, relative to the bulk-grid reference. Read-only observability point.
points.label: Internal Voltage Angle
points.name: ThetaInv

points.desc: Internal voltage magnitude of the GFM oscillator.
points.label: Internal Voltage Magnitude
points.name: EInv

points.desc: Measured rate-of-change of frequency at the inverter terminal.
points.label: Measured ROCOF
points.name: ROCOF

points.desc: Portion of delivered active power attributable to the inertial response term (M * d-omega/dt).
points.label: Inertial Power Contribution
points.name: PInert

points.desc: Portion of delivered active power attributable to the droop response term.
points.label: Droop Power Contribution
points.name: PDroop

points.desc: Portion of delivered active power attributable to the dispatch reference.
points.label: Reference Power Contribution
points.name: PRef

points.desc: Portion of delivered active power attributable to the synchronizing-torque term (internal angle tracking against the grid).
points.label: Synchronizing Power Contribution
points.name: PSync

points.desc: Portion of delivered active power attributable to the damper term (transient frequency component).
points.label: Damper Power Contribution
points.name: PDamper

points.desc: Current angle stroke utilization as a fraction of MaxAng.
points.label: Angle Stroke Utilization
points.name: AngStroke

points.desc: Synchronization tracking status — distinct from GridSt, which is the commanded-mode state machine.
points.label: Synchronization Status
points.name: SyncStat

points.desc: Flag set when the inverter has demoted itself from commanded GFM to fall-back GFL (e.g. under current saturation when LimMode = MODE_SWITCH).
points.label: Mode Demoted
points.name: ModeDemoted

points.desc: Black-start enable. When set, on a dead-bus condition the inverter ramps its terminal V/Hz from zero up to nominal over BSDwell + ramp envelope.
points.label: Black-Start Enable
points.name: BSEna

points.desc: Voltage ramp rate during a black-start sequence.
points.label: Black-Start V Ramp
points.name: BSVRamp

points.desc: Frequency ramp rate during a black-start sequence.
points.label: Black-Start Hz Ramp
points.name: BSHzRamp

points.desc: Dwell time at zero V/Hz before starting the black-start ramp.
points.label: Black-Start Dwell
points.name: BSDwell

points.desc: Anti-islanding override. In GFM mode the inverter is intentionally the island; this point gates whether the inverter's own AI logic will trip it.
points.label: Anti-Islanding Override
points.name: AIOvr

points.desc: Synchronization logic enable for closing into a live grid from off-grid operation.
points.label: Sync Enable
points.name: SyncEna

points.desc: Voltage-magnitude tolerance window for synchronization, per-unit.
points.label: Sync Voltage Tolerance
points.name: SyncVTol

points.desc: Frequency tolerance window for synchronization.
points.label: Sync Frequency Tolerance
points.name: SyncHzTol

points.desc: Angle tolerance window for synchronization.
points.label: Sync Angle Tolerance
points.name: SyncAngTol

points.desc: Role of this unit within a multi-inverter site.
points.label: Unit Role
points.name: UnitRole

points.desc: Unit identifier within the local cluster (1 = leader by default).
points.label: Unit ID
points.name: UnitID

points.desc: Leader-mode frequency authority gain (applies only when UnitRole = LEADER).
points.label: Leader Hz Authority Gain
points.name: LeaderHzGain

points.desc: Scale factor for voltage points.
points.label: Voltage Scale Factor
points.name: V_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for current points.
points.label: Current Scale Factor
points.name: A_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for frequency points.
points.label: Frequency Scale Factor
points.name: Hz_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for active-power points.
points.label: Active Power Scale Factor
points.name: W_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for reactive-power points.
points.label: Reactive Power Scale Factor
points.name: Var_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for percent points.
points.label: Percent Scale Factor
points.name: Pct_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for active-power ramp rates.
points.label: Active Power Ramp Scale Factor
points.name: WRmp_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for voltage ramp rates.
points.label: Voltage Ramp Scale Factor
points.name: VRmp_SF

points.desc: Scale factor for frequency ramp rates.
points.label: Frequency Ramp Scale Factor
points.name: HzRmp_SF
